name: quickstart-step-count-ab
hypothesis: Reducing the canonical quickstart from 8 to 5 steps raises task completion from about 60% to at least 75% without raising error rate above 10%.

metrics.name: task_completion_rate
metrics.definition: Share of sessions that reach and independently verify the quickstart outcome.

metrics.name: time_to_first_value_s
metrics.definition: Wall-clock seconds from opening the quickstart to verified first value, per the magic-path timer.

metrics.name: error_rate
metrics.definition: Share of sessions with at least one unresolved error or failed step.

metrics.name: drop_off_per_step
metrics.definition: Share of sessions abandoning before the outcome at each step.

metrics.name: support_load_per_100
metrics.definition: Tickets or escalations attributable to the flow per 100 sessions.
